map.从混合文本中剔除英文、数字与符号，仅提取并保留中文字符，适用于清理外文网页抓取内: Removes English letters, digits, and symbols from mixed text and keeps only Chinese characters. Suitable for cleaning up foreign-language web content or preprocessing Chinese corpora, running fully locally in your browser.
map.从混合文本抽中文：去除英文/数字/符号，得到纯中文，便于中文 NLP 或校对。: Pull Chinese out of mixed text: strip English, digits, and symbols to get pure Chinese, ready for Chinese NLP or proofreading.
map.清洗外文资料：保留中文正文、剔除夹杂的拉丁字符。: Clean foreign-language material: keep the Chinese body text and drop interleaved Latin characters.
map.双语对照准备：先抽中文再抽英文，分别处理。: Bilingual comparison prep: extract Chinese first, then English, and process them separately.
map.：输入「你好world 123」，提取中文输出「你好」，过滤掉拉丁字母与数字；可: : enter "nihao world 123" and extracting the Chinese gives "nihao", filtering out Latin letters and digits; useful for counting pure Chinese characters or denoising text.
map.默认保留常用中文标点（，。！？等），只去非中文字母数字；如需连标点也去，用「仅保: Common Chinese punctuation (full-width comma, full stop, question and exclamation marks) is kept by default and only non-Chinese letters and digits are removed; to strip punctuation too, use the "Chinese characters only" mode.
map.繁体算中文吗？: Do Traditional Characters Count as Chinese?
map.算。繁体汉字属 CJK 统一区，会被保留；如需简繁分离可先转简再提取。: Yes. Traditional characters belong to the CJK Unified Ideographs block and are kept; to separate simplified from traditional, convert to simplified first and then extract.
